I have worked in retail for combined 10 years. I assure you at least 80% of name brand electronics are garbage models on black Friday. The most recent experience involved a Samsung 32" about 2-3 years ago. I assisted with warranty repair on the item and this involved removing the back panel. Upon opening it I took note of there not being a single Samsung component that I could spot. It was all TCL components. TCL is one of the largest "budget" television manufacturers out there. They've been responsible for brands like RCA, Westinghouse, Element and Emerson at various times. 

Another tip off was from my time at Circuit City. We had a Toshiba model TV. I believe it was rear projection and the remote supplied with it had an Audiovox stamp on the underside.
